description: Make a grocery list and a checkout link. Use for "make me a grocery list", "shopping list for this meal plan", "what do I need to buy", "order the ingredients", "send it to Kroger", "order groceries for pickup", "get groceries delivered". Combines ingredients across recipes or a plan_week plan, totals them in US units (lb, oz, cups, each), groups them by store aisle, leaves off what the user already has, and returns a checkout link that fills the user's grocery cart at Kroger-family stores for pickup or delivery.

have_on_hand.description: Items the user already has; they are left off the list.

recipes.description: Catalog recipes to shop for, with how many servings to make.

skip_pantry_staples.description: Leave off salt, pepper, oil, flour, sugar and common spices.

name: build_shopping_list

url.description: Open to add every item to a cart and check out. Show this link to the user.

skipped.description: Items left off because the user has them or they are pantry staples.

title: Grocery List & Checkout
